name: Image to 3D
tagline: ImageTo3D is an advanced AI-powered platform that transforms 2D images into high-quality 3D models
description: ImageTo3D is an advanced AI-powered platform that transforms 2D images into high-quality 3D models. It supports multiple output formats including GLB, OBJ, and STL, making it ideal for 3D printing, game development, and product design. The platform leverages cutting-edge AI models like Trellis 2, Hunyuan 3D, and Seed3D to deliver production-ready 3D files with high-fidelity textures.
